source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = (1, 3, 5, 7, 9)
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                continue
            if r < 2 or c < 2:
                out[r][c] = 1
            elif r == 2 or c == 2:
                out[r][c] = 4
            else:
                # The patterned field advances one place in both directions.
                index = (1 + r - 8 + c - 3) % len(colors)
                out[r][c] = colors[index]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
